description.value:
The namazus are a short, chubby, catfish-like beast tribe native to Othard, known for love of festivals, coin, and their talent for craftsmanship.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Namazus gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Constitution.
  • Size: Namazus are Small creatures.
  • Type: Namazus are Humanoid creatures with the namazu subtype.
  • Base Speed: Namazus have a base speed of 30 feet and a swim speed of 30 feet with a +8 racial bonus to swim checks.
  • Languages: Namazus begin with Common and Aquan. Namazus with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Elvaan, Lalafellan, Mithran, Roegadyn, and Vieran.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Hold Breath: Namazus can hold their breath for 4x their Constitution score in rounds.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Craftsman: Namazus gain a +2 racial bonus on Craft or Profession checks to create objects from cloth, leather, or wood.
  • Craftsman Knowledge: Namazus gain Knowledge (technology) and Knowledge (engineering) as class skills.
  • Festive Culture: Namazus receive a +2 racial bonus on Appraise, Disguise, and Perform checks.
  • Skilled Traders: Namazus gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Water Sense: Namazus gain blindsense 30 feet against creatures touching the same body of water.
